headToHead: Tampa Bay snap a four-game losing skid to open 2026 with a 24-16 victory at AT&T Stadium.
headline: Buccaneers 24, Cowboys 16: Daniels delivers first win on TNF
whyCareReason: Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels led Tampa Bay to a 24-16 victory at Dallas for the Buccaneers' first win of 2026.
teaser: Daniels threw for 189 yards and a score while Bucky Irving found the end zone twice. Dallas drops to 2-3.
story: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers earned their first victory of the 2026 season on Thursday night, defeating the Dallas Cowboys 24-16 at AT&T Stadium. Backup quarterback Jalon Daniels, making his second career start in place of injured Baker Mayfield, completed 19 of 25 passes for 189 yards and one touchdown while adding 23 yards on the ground. Bucky Irving proved pivotal, catching a 5-yard touchdown and scoring on the ground as Tampa Bay generated a season-high 419 total yards. For Dallas, George Pickens caught 9 passes for 130 yards and a touchdown, but Dak Prescott and the Cowboys offense could not overcome late penalties. Tampa Bay improves to 1-4 while Dallas falls to 2-3. Kansas City, Minnesota and San Francisco remain the league's unbeaten teams at 4-0.
stakes: Tampa Bay avoids an 0-5 start and climbs off the bottom of the NFC South. Dallas falls behind in the NFC East before Philadelphia plays Sunday.
rivalryAngle: Tampa Bay secures their first road win over Dallas since 2022 behind an inspired backup quarterback.
